summary: @qlik/embed-react preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Version 2.5.3 declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, per-function string-lookup tables) and downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/`, extracts and chmod +x's the binary in a temp directory, then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])` to run a sibling file. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated payload using string-array shift-rotator obfuscation (`WV8StW`) with a 3000+ entry constant table (`n7gIxM`) and hex-mangled identifiers. The naming (`math_init`) is unrelated to the package's advertised React-embed purpose, and executing the payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime (Bun) evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. The payload runs unconditionally on install with no verification, no pinning to a documented publisher artifact, and no relationship to any legitimate build step for a React embed library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
